Telangana to Host Khelo India Youth Games 2026

Telangana has been selected to host the Khelo India Youth Games in November 2026. The announcement indicates the state will be the venue for this significant sporting event. Further details regarding the specific nature of the games, such as whether they will be summer or winter, are not yet clarified in the provided information.
